exact: asexual reproduction resulting in the formation of a cellular spore
broad: asexual sporulation resulting in the formation of a viable spore

definition: The formation of a cellular spore derived from the products of mitosis. A cellular spore is a cell form that can be used for dissemination, for survival of adverse conditions because of its heat and desiccation resistance, and/or for reproduction.
label: asexual sporulation resulting in formation of a cellular spore
